name: Mechanical Reaction Core
exclusions: Exitor-Rho must remain adjacent to the target for Optimised Gait to trigger.
Actus must repair another friendly Mechanical unit that has a target in range to trigger Galvanic Field.
Do not use Adeptus Mechanicus characters where the encounter disallows that faction.

sources.notes: Current top-score Guild Raid compositions repeatedly pair Actus with Exitor-Rho in mechanical teams.
Galvanic Field triggers an immediate attack from another repaired Mechanical unit.
Optimised Gait and Chordclaw define Exitor-Rho's repeated reaction-damage role.
